blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — From the UAAP Season 77 girls’ volleyball tournament in 2014 through the seniors division, Lams Lamina played in the finals every year with National University. After years of winning championships at NU, Lamina faced a different start to her professional career as the No. 1 overall pick as the Galeries Tower Highrisers settled for a last place in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series, winning just one of their eight games. Lamina ended her first series with Galeries falling short against Capital1, which played without her longtime NU teammate Bella Belen due to illness, 26-28, 25-19, 21-25, […]...
